ValidationRule.description: Signed Letter of Intent requires NDA Signed Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Validation_Rules__c && NOT($Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Executing__c) && $RecordType.Name = "MPS Deals" && ISPICKVAL(TSGADX__Sales_Stage__c , "Sign Letter of Intent") && ISBLANK( TSGADX__NDA_Signed__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The sales stage of "Signed Letter of Intent" requires the NDA Signed date to be filled in.
